top_signals.title: How Europe Comes Apart
top_signals.summary: The European Union is entering a period of political instability that could threaten its future—not through its formal dissolution, but through the gradual erosion of its capacity to act. In recent months, Europe has been engulfed in protests driven by a common crisis of affordability, deteriorating public services, and declining confidence in governments’ ability to improve living standards, especially for young people.

top_signals.title: New York Bets $228 Million on the Future of Offshore Wind
top_signals.summary: New York plans to invest in its port infrastructure as part of long-term plans to develop offshore wind. Preparing the region’s ports will help facilitate offshore wind activities in the future. In November, New York’s Governor Kathy Hochul announced that the state would be investing more than $228 million in five projects to strengthen maritime infrastructure.
